@@ Power Point Development
@description:
 Descriptions A character’s total Power Point (PP) is equal to his Power
 Development skill bonus. This skill allows a spell user to increase the
 total number of power points he may hold at any given The skill bonus
 progression for this skill is found on the Abilities Table T–1.1 (note that
 a Hybridspell user mst lesser of his two realm’s progressions) A Hybrid
 spell averages his Realm stat bonuses to obtain his stat bonus skill. • • •
 In order to cast a spell, a number of PPs equal to the spell’s must be
 used. Each character has a maximum number of Points (PPs) equal to his
 skill bonus for Power Point Development (see Appendix A-1.22). Normally,
 this skill bonus consists of the following: PP Development skill bonus = PP
 Total = “realm” stat bonus + profession bonus + skill rank bonus + any
 special bonuses Recovering PPs: Once a character’s PPs are used casting
 they may be regained (up to the maximum) in the following ways: 1) If the
 character is active, one PP is recovered every three hours. Rolemaster
 Standard Rules 184
